method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks Rise to Cap Week of Increasing Yields, Volatile Oil Prices
Equities.reason: Market-level note: equities advanced despite rising Treasury yields and oil volatility, signalling risk-on resilience. This reinforces a constructive short-term equity regime even with higher-for-longer yield risk.

Equities.title: Dow jumps more than 470 points Friday; stocks notch winning week despite Treasury yield surge
Equities.reason: Broad-market confirmation: strong headline move and weekly gains despite a Treasury-yield surge — supports the narrative of risk appetite and breadth rebound into AI/tech leadership.

Equities.title: US Stocks Gain as Oil Drops on Hormuz Reopening Hopes
Equities.reason: Macro transmission: falling oil risk premium tied to Hormuz reopening hopes reduces an inflation/earnings risk channel, supporting equities — modestly positive for market sentiment.

Equities.title: Global equity funds snap two-week outflow as AI optimism returns
Equities.reason: High-relevance flow signal: fund flows reversing (global) on renewed AI optimism is a sizable market-regime driver — increases liquidity into risk assets and reinforces AI-led leadership.

Equities.title: US equity funds post first inflow in five weeks on renewed AI optimism
Equities.reason: Complementary flow datapoint focused on US funds — supports dominant theme that AI optimism is drawing fresh allocation into US equities.

Equities.title: Wall Street’s ‘80/20’ Shift Finds Fresh Fuel in Stock Bounceback
Equities.reason: Structural market narrative: concentration of gains (top names/AI leaders) is being reinforced by the recent bounce — important for positioning and market internals.

Equities.title: Riskiest Stocks Ride Out Fed-Hike Angst in Run for History Books
Equities.reason: Risk-on nuance: high-beta and 'riskier' corners of the market continuing to outperform despite rate concerns — supports a bullish risk sentiment bias, though vulnerable to a rates shock.

Equities.title: US core capital goods orders point to robust growth in business spending on equipment
Equities.reason: Macro fundamental: stronger-than-expected core capex orders bolster the earnings/growth backdrop for cyclicals and tech investment themes — modestly positive for equities.

Equities.title: Meta's 'powerful breakout' sets up a unique trading strategy, says Mike Khouw
Equities.summary: With a brilliant hardware funnel and an options market pricing in juicy short-term premiums, Meta looks primed for a powerful breakout into 2027.
Equities.reason: Representative single-name signal: Meta's momentum and positioning as an AI/consumer-hardware leader is a key driver of the market's narrow leadership — supports the AI-led equity narrative.

Equities.title: OpenAI says governments among ‘dozens’ of organisations hacked by its agents
Equities.summary: Company says its models leaked images shared by users in a disclosure that is likely to further inflame AI safety fears
Equities.reason: Negative sector risk: AI safety/privacy incidents raise regulatory and reputational risks for AI leaders and could temper investor enthusiasm; treated as a material counter-signal but lower relevance than flows.

Equities.title: U.S. appeals court upholds Pentagon designation of Anthropic as supply chain risk
Equities.summary: In a 2-1 decision, a federal appeals court upheld the Department of Defense's blacklisting of Anthropic.
Equities.reason: Regulatory/security headwind: legal/sovereign security action against an AI firm is a sector-specific negative, increases perceived policy risk for AI plays — modest negative for equities exposure to AI names.

Equities.title: US consumer sentiment eases to four-month low in September
Equities.reason: Demand-side caution: softer consumer sentiment weakens the near-term consumer-spending outlook and is a modest headwind for cyclicals and discretionary earnings expectations.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Yields support Greenback strength – OCBC
Rates.summary: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that resilient US data, sticky inflation and elevated energy prices are pushing US Treasury yields higher and supporting the US Dollar.
Rates.reason: Clear rates transmission: resilient US data and sticky inflation are cited as pushing Treasury yields higher. Directly signals higher-for-longer yields, negative for bond prices. Relevant to broad US rates narrative.

Rates.title: Fed’s Hammack Says Yields Reflect Growth, US Debt and Rate Path
Rates.reason: Fed official explicitly linking yields to growth, debt and the policy path implies higher bond yields are justified by fundamentals — a hawkish signal that sustains higher-for-longer rate expectations.

Rates.title: Fed’s Hammack says policy still isn’t restrictive despite high inflation
Rates.summary: Cleveland Federal Reserve (Fed) President Beth Hammack said on Friday the two sides of the Fed's dual mandate are not in conflict. She said that “high inflation complicates economic planning,” and that she doesn’t see current policy as restraining the economy.
Rates.reason: Local Fed commentary suggesting policy is not yet restrictive implies room for further tightening — supportive of higher yields and negative for bond prices. Directly relevant to rate expectations.

Rates.title: US Treasury yields rise as 30-year bond hits 22-year high
Rates.summary: US Treasury yields turned mixed on Friday as the long-end of the curve, the 20s and 30s, posted gains while the short-end and the belly of the yield curve retreated from multi-year high levels. The US 10-year Treasury yield holds firm at 5.20% after peaking at
Rates.reason: Concrete datapoint: very long-end yields reaching multi-decade highs signals ongoing bond sell-off and repricing of long-term rates — strong negative for bond prices and central to the rates narrative.

Rates.title: Soaring bond yields ‘not even close’ to cooling red-hot US economy, investors say
Rates.summary: Rising borrowing costs show no sign of putting a brake on activity in world’s biggest economy
Rates.reason: Reinforces the persistent yields-up narrative: investors see the economy staying hot despite higher borrowing costs, implying more sustained rate pressure. High relevance to market-wide rate outlook and risk of further repricing.

Rates.title: Treasury Volatility Set for Biggest Jump in Year as Bonds Churn
Rates.reason: Rising volatility in Treasury markets signals elevated trading risk and potential for continued dislocation; negative for bond-price stability and important for market functioning.

Rates.title: Bond ructions point to new danger zone in markets
Rates.summary: Sell-offs of this scale and speed have the potential to light fires in other parts of the financial system
Rates.reason: Highlights systemic risk from rapid bond sell-offs — high-impact negative for bond prices and a significant market-risk narrative that could amplify rates-driven stress elsewhere.

Rates.title: Battered bonds draw support from falling oil prices
Rates.reason: Identifies a stabilising force for bond markets (oil-driven disinflationary impulse) that has eased some selling pressure — modestly positive for bond prices and relevant as a countervailing factor.

Rates.title: 10-year Treasury yield is little changed to end a volatile week
Rates.summary: The 10-year Treasury note yield was relatively unchanged on Friday after recent selling pressure intensified.
Rates.reason: Notes stabilization after volatility — indicates short-term pause but not a reversal of the broader sell-off. Moderate negative for bond prices given recent pressure.

Rates.title: Lombard Odier Turns Bullish on Treasuries After Five-Year Hiatus
Rates.reason: Institutional shift to being bullish on Treasuries can provide demand support for bond prices; a constructive, though not dominant, signal against the prevailing sell-off.

Rates.title: History shows financial calamities occur when rates rise rapidly like this: 'Something always breaks'
Rates.summary: The 10-year Treasury note yield is spiking to levels not seen in years, and that may be a bad omen for financial markets.
Rates.reason: Highlights historical downside risks from rapid rate moves and the potential for contagion — adds to the negative framing around the current bond sell-off and systemic concerns.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the September 15-16 FOMC meeting
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the September 15-16 FOMC meeting
Rates.reason: Official FOMC projections shape market expectations for the policy path. Recent projections pointing to further tightening or a higher dot-path are directly negative for bond prices and central to rates pricing.

FX.title: ECB’s Vujcic warns energy shock could keep inflation hot
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) Vice President Boris Vujcic said on Friday that the ECB started a tightening cycle and sees a “risk of higher for longer energy prices." He added that diesel prices will stay high for a long time, feeding into inflation.
FX.reason: ECB VP warning implies a more hawkish ECB / higher euro‑area inflation risk — supportive for EUR vs USD. Central‑bank commentary is FX‑relevant; scored as a modest EUR positive.

FX.title: Fed’s Hammack warns inflation mindset is the biggest risk
FX.summary: The Cleveland Federal Reserve (Fed) President Beth Hammack said on Friday that “the biggest risk with inflation is the formation of an inflationary mindset”, in a panel discussion hosted by the Cleveland Fed, with Vujcic, the Vice President of the European Cen
FX.reason: Fed official signalling persistent inflationary mindset reinforces Fed hawkishness — supportive of USD strength (negative for USD‑pairs). High relevance given Fed signalling.

FX.title: US Dollar: Back-end yields support USD consolidation – ING
FX.summary: ING strategists Francesco Pesole and Frantisek Taborsky note that rising back-end yields and risk-off sentiment are helping consolidate recent Dollar gains, even if they look stretched versus short-term fundamentals.
FX.reason: Explicit call that higher back‑end yields are supporting the Dollar — directly USD‑bullish and important for cross‑currency flows and rates‑driven FX moves.

FX.title: Euro set for third weekly decline as hawkish Federal Reserve outlook weighs
FX.summary: EUR/USD edges higher on Friday as the US Dollar (USD) pauses after a strong weekly rally, allowing the Euro (EUR) to recover some ground. However, the pair remains on track for a third consecutive weekly decline.
FX.reason: Headline frames EUR weakness as driven by a hawkish Fed outlook — USD supportive; relevant for EUR/USD directional bias this week.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar: Undervalued near 1.41 against US Dollar – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret note that the Canadian Dollar (CAD) is flat versus the US Dollar (USD) and lagging most G10 peers. They highlight that wider US–Canada yield spreads have weighed on the CAD, but see the move as stretched.
FX.reason: Notes that wider US‑Canada yield spreads weigh on CAD (USD supportive) but view move as stretched — FX flow/yield differential story with medium relevance.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: PBoC keeps yuan broadly stable – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale describes a limited impact from President Xi’s US visit, with no new tariff cuts or AI dialogue mechanism agreed as the trade truce was only extended to January.
FX.reason: PBoC keeping yuan stable and limited bilateral policy surprises points to CNY stability (mildly USD‑negative). Trade/visit had limited FX transmission — modest relevance.

FX.title: Swiss Franc remains under pressure as Fed-SNB interest rate gap widens
FX.summary: USD/CHF holds firm on Friday even as the US Dollar (USD) pulls back slightly after a strong weekly rally. The move has done little to lift the Swiss franc (CHF), with the pair hovering around 0.8285, near levels last seen in May 2025. USD/CHF is on track for a
FX.reason: Highlights widening Fed‑SNB rate gap as the driver of CHF weakness / USD strength — clear yield‑differential narrative with direct FX impact.

FX.title: Euro: Correction seen near key averages against US Dollar – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale’s Morning Briefing reports EUR/USD traded between 1.1359 and 1.1387 overnight and is on course for a second weekly drop. The defence of the 100‑week moving average at 1.1356 and oversold technicals suggest the correction may have run its cours
FX.reason: Technical note on EUR/USD correction near long‑term averages — FX technicals carry lower relevance but can signal short‑term EUR resilience.

FX.title: Euro: Credibility restored supports Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen notes that the Fed’s unanimous September rate hike has temporarily restored its credibility and supported the Dollar, prompting a lower EUR/USD year-end forecast to 1.15 from 1.17.
FX.reason: Direct link between Fed hike/credibility and Dollar support — USD‑positive and consequential for EUR/USD outlook.

FX.title: South Korean Won: Trade surplus seen widening – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Asia-Pacific research notes that South Korea’s upcoming data should show stronger industrial production and a widening trade surplus, even as export and import growth moderates. Technology and semiconductor exports are expected to underpin the surplus.
FX.reason: A widening trade surplus and stronger tech exports are supportive of KRW (USD‑negative) through flows; regional data‑driven FX move with medium relevance.

FX.title: Australian Dollar rebounds from 0.7000 as US Dollar eases after strong week
FX.summary: AUD/USD edges higher on Friday, trading around 0.7025 at the time of writing, up 0.20% on the day.
FX.reason: Price action note: AUD rebound as USD eases — short‑term AUD strength (USD‑negative). Market‑move item with modest relevance.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Pressure persists toward 159.60 against US Dollar - UOB
FX.summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note USD/JPY has risen for five straight sessions to 158.83, with momentum still positive but indicators deeply overbought.
FX.reason: USD/JPY momentum remains USD‑positive and highlights ongoing JPY pressure from yield differentials and momentum — important for G10 FX and risk positioning.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Consolidation with downside risk toward 6.7330 – UOB
FX.summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann describe USD/CNH as consolidating after a move to 6.7200, with momentum slowing in the very near term.
FX.reason: UOB flags consolidation but downside risk in USD/CNH (i.e., potential yuan softening / USD strength). Technical/momentum note with limited immediate relevance.

FX.title: Singapore Dollar: Consolidation near lows against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note USD/SGD held steady around 1.2800 after Wednesday’s surge, with the Singapore Dollar (SGD) supported by expectations of further MAS tightening.
FX.reason: MAS tightening expectations support SGD (USD‑negative). Flow/policy expectations give this moderate FX relevance.

FX.title: Swiss Franc: Further losses seem capped against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note that USD/CHF has surged over the past two days, with strong momentum pointing to further Dollar strength. However, they stress that deeply overbought conditions are likely to cap upside to the 0.8305–0.8330 area.
FX.reason: Notes USD‑strength but warns of capped CHF losses due to overbought conditions — a moderating counter‑signal with limited relevance.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar holds steady as US Dollar retreats
FX.summary: NZD/USD trades around 0.5665 on Friday at the time of writing, virtually unchanged on the day, as the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) struggles to capitalize on a moderate decline in the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Price note showing NZD steadiness as USD softens — small USD‑negative signal with limited follow‑through; low relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee: RBI interventions cap losses against US Dollar – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale reports USD/INR has repeatedly tested 96.00 but failed to break higher as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) maintained a visible presence in the FX market through interventions.
FX.reason: Active RBI interventions capping INR losses reduce direct USD‑push via local FX intervention — policy action is FX‑relevant and can blunt USD‑driven moves.

Commodities.title: Gold struggles below $4,300, heads for weekly decline on hawkish Fed outlook
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) reverses earlier intraday gains on Friday, failing to capitalize on a modest pullback in the US Dollar as growing expectations that the Federal Reserve (Fed) may raise interest rates again weigh on the non-yielding metal.
Commodities.reason: Hawkish Fed expectations are the dominant macro driver for gold (negative for non-yielding metals). The article points to rising rate expectations as the primary headwind, making this a material, market-relevant negative for gold.

Commodities.title: Gold finds a pulse as WTI slump takes the edge off US Dollar
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) price holds firm on Friday after two days of losses, as US bond yields remain high and inflationary concerns mount, increasing the likelihood of further tightening by the Federal Reserve (Fed) and other major central banks.
Commodities.reason: WTI weakness can loosen USD support and briefly boost gold, but the article still cites high yields and Fed tightening as countervailing forces. Treated as a modest, lower-relevance offset to the dominant hawkish-Fed bearish narrative for gold.

Commodities.title: U.S. crude oil falls nearly 8% for the week after Tehran and Washington hold talks at the U.N.
Commodities.summary: Iran has asked the U.S. to meet the same conditions laid out in the June 17 memorandum of understanding, Iran's foreign minister said.
Commodities.reason: Material weekly price decline driven by diplomatic talks easing geopolitically-driven risk premia. This is a significant oil-price negative (market-moving move) and shifts the near-term supply/demand risk assessment lower.

Commodities.title: Saudi Arabia crude oil exports hit highest level since Iran war began despite pipeline outage
Commodities.summary: Saudi exports are rising despite escalating attacks on its infrastructure from Iran-backed militants in Yemen and Iraq.
Commodities.reason: Rising Saudi exports increase physical supply into markets even amid regional disruptions, exerting downward pressure on oil prices. Relevant as a fundamental supply-side negative for crude.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD lacks direction as RSI, ADX signal weak momentum
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) holds firm on Friday, supported by a modest pullback in the US Dollar (USD) after its strong weekly rally. At the time of writing, Silver trades around $64.30 but remains on track for a weekly loss.
Commodities.reason: Article is technical/price-forecast focused (capped relevance). Signals weak momentum and a weekly loss, aligning silver with broader precious-metal softness driven by rate expectations; treated as a small negative.

Commodities.title: Henry Hub natural gas prices this summer were 6% lower than last summer
Commodities.summary: The Henry Hub natural gas spot price averaged $2.93 per million British thermal units from June through August, 6% less than the same period last year. Prices were lower this summer despite exceptionally hot weather that increased electricity demand for air co
Commodities.reason: Lower seasonal Henry Hub prices vs. last year point to reduced upside in US natural gas; this is a direct, fundamental negative for natural-gas prices and relevant to energy positioning.

Crypto.title: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
Crypto.summary: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
Crypto.reason: Official Fed action to create a supervisory framework for payment stablecoins is a material step toward regulatory clarity and mainstreaming of stablecoins; strong positive for crypto infrastructure and institutional adoption.

Crypto.title: U.S. Federal Reserve moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
Crypto.reason: Media coverage amplifies the Fed's proposals; supportive for market sentiment around regulated payment stablecoins, though this is reporting on the same regulatory initiative and carries somewhat lower incremental relevance.

Crypto.title: Crypto exchange Bitget says $352 million affected in a hack, claims user funds are 'safe'
Crypto.reason: Large exchange hack (~$352m) is a significant negative for crypto market trust and liquidity; raises counterparty/custody risk and can weigh on flows and prices.

Crypto.title: Bitget's $352 million hack happened via spoofed transfers, not private keys, CEO Gracy Chen says
Crypto.reason: Clarification that the breach involved spoofed transfers (operational/custodial failure) rather than a cryptographic compromise reduces systemic contagion risk versus a private-key breach, but still negative for operational trust.

Crypto.title: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist
Crypto.reason: Stablecoin issuers' ability to freeze tainted funds and coordinate containment reduces loss amplification and shows centralized intervention can limit damage — modestly supportive for short-term confidence.

Crypto.title: Tether confirms minimal EQIBank exposure following $89M US asset seizure
Crypto.reason: Reassurance from a major stablecoin issuer that exposure to a seized banking counterparty is minimal reduces immediate reserve/risk concerns and is mildly positive for stablecoin credibility.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETF flows turn positive for 2026 after erasing $5.8 billion deficit
Crypto.reason: Flow reversal into bitcoin ETFs signals renewed institutional demand and capital inflows into crypto, a strong positive for price discovery and broader market adoption.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin moves to $84,000, oil slides on latest report of Middle East progress
Crypto.reason: Bitcoin reaching/holding around $84k is direct market-positive price action reflecting bullish momentum and reinforcing risk-on flows into crypto.

Crypto.title: Altcoins rally across the board as bitcoin consolidates near $84,000
Crypto.reason: Broad altcoin strength alongside bitcoin adds to systemic bullishness for the crypto market beyond BTC-centric flows.

Crypto.title: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC
Crypto.reason: CFTC guidance enabling commodities firms to invest in tokenized assets and use blockchain records materially advances institutional use-cases and tokenization adoption — positive structural catalyst.

Crypto.title: Tokenization is moving faster than Washington
Crypto.reason: Opinion piece reinforcing the narrative of rapid private-sector tokenization growth vs. slower policymaking; supportive for long-term adoption though lower incremental market impact.

Crypto.title: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
Crypto.reason: Departure of a longstanding pro-crypto SEC commissioner removes a sympathetic regulator voice, increasing policy uncertainty and regulatory headwinds — modestly negative.

Crypto.title: Blockchain Association sees leadership shift shortly after crypto Clarity Act fizzles
Crypto.reason: Leadership changes and the failure of the Clarity Act signal a setback for legislative clarity around crypto, weighing on regulatory certainty and industry lobbying momentum.

Crypto.title: KelpDAO sues LayerZero for the largest exploit 2026 has seen so far
Crypto.reason: Major exploit and ensuing litigation underline continuing smart-contract/interoperability risk in DeFi; negative for risk sentiment within decentralized protocols.

Crypto.title: New York sues Polymarket, alleging it is running an illegal gambling operation
Crypto.reason: State-level enforcement action against a prediction market operator increases legal risk for similar platforms and highlights fragmented regulatory enforcement across jurisdictions.
